name: cairn

commands.lint: npm run lint && npm run check

cairn.purpose: The interface: every screen a person sees (protection, reaches, reflection), React and TypeScript, running unelevated

commands.typecheck: cd src-tauri && cargo check -p cairn --no-default-features --features history --all-targets && cargo check -p cairn-helper --all-targets
commands.lint: cd src-tauri && cargo clippy -p cairn --no-default-features --all-targets --message-format=short -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p cairn --no-default-features --features history --all-targets --message-format=short -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p cairn-helper --all-targets --message-format=short -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all --check
commands.test: cd src-tauri && cargo test -p cairn --no-default-features && cargo test -p cairn --no-default-features --features history && cargo test -p cairn-helper

src-tauri.purpose: The core and the privileged helper: domain, encrypted stores, the enforcement layers, IPC, and every elevated write with its teardown
